rule: A host version that is not pinned is unsupported for that host only. It does not mark another host or a metric category unsupported.
pass_condition: A pinned host passes only when a real smoke collects a Skill or Tool call event. A parser fixture is not that evidence. Failure marks only that host unsupported.

completion_gate.statement: Fallback completion gate from ADR 0001 section 6: at least one pinned host must collect a Skill or Tool call event in a real smoke for the component-call requirement to count as done. If both pinned hosts end up unsupported, the R1 gate fails and returns to the user for a new decision; it must not be released.
